about_the_game:
Everslide: Infinite Sliding Puzzle Game
Relax, Solve & Master Dynamic Tile Grids

Everslide reinvents sliding puzzles with an endless series of procedurally generated grids that evolve with every move. Designed for smooth, intuitive gameplay, it combines classic puzzle mechanics with modern features to create a continuously engaging experience.

Key Features:

  • ENDLESS PUZZLES: Infinite, procedurally generated grids ensure each game is unique.

  • DAILY PUZZLES: A new, time-limited challenge each day offers structured goals.

  • SPEEDRUN MODE: Solve puzzles as quickly as possible and test your efficiency under pressure.

  • 7 DIFFICULTY LEVELS: From relaxed beginner grids to complex expert challenges.

  • ADAPTIVE GAMEPLAY: Puzzle complexity adjusts naturally to the structure of the grid.

  • STRESS-FREE EXPERIENCE: Classic mode has no timers or forced moves—slide tiles at your own pace.

  • MINIMALIST VISUALS: Clean, simple design keeps focus on the puzzles themselves.

  • STRATEGIC VARIATION: Each puzzle requires planning and foresight, encouraging logical thinking.

Slide tiles, tackle daily challenges, race against the clock, or simply explore infinite grids at your own pace. With Everslide, the possibilities are endless—every session is a new test of strategy, speed, and puzzle-solving skill.
